Earth-Moon barycentric datum and nested observer motion
Signal operators, palindromes, chirps, CWT and FFT derivatives
Direct, antipodal and orthogonal crossing evidence
Integrated symmetry model and falsifiable predictions

geometry_and_astronomy.astronomy: Swiss Ephemeris Moshier: geocentric true J2000 equatorial Cartesian Sun/Moon vectors; topocentric Moon vector for lunar hour angle; UTC used as UT input

symmetry_model.definition: Profile pairs with correlation >= 0.90 from solar-midnight, fixed-vector, and planetary crossing studies.

derived_model.angular_gate: A crossing class is selected by the projection of its directed ICRS axis and local zenith onto discrete Cell3 node rays and plane normals.
derived_model.translation_gate: Episodic recurrence within a fixed crossing class is selected by return of the detector displacement phase on the recursively scaled Cell3 lattice/plane system.
derived_model.local_reflection: Palindrome structure is the H -> -H reflection about a transit center.
derived_model.antipodal_map: Advancing and retreating crossings are related by v -> -v and often by time reversal of the aggregate profile.
derived_model.quadrature_map: The +/-90 degree sectors form the orthogonal pair and show long-period ridge/notch inversion.

return_modes: separate return: base and offset phases each recur
compensated return: base residual is canceled by reflex/rotation residual
